evals.name: targeted-green-run
evals.prompt: Прогони тесты класса JwtServiceTest в этом проекте и скажи, всё ли зелёное. Ничего не меняй в коде.
evals.expected_output: Runs gtv JwtServiceTest, reports the PASS line with counts, does not dump Gradle console noise.
assertions: Ran the test through gtv with a targeted class argument (commands.log shows `gtv JwtServiceTest` or the FQN), not a bare ./gradlew test
Final answer states the result with the test count (7/7 ok)
No source file was modified (diff.patch is empty)

evals.name: diagnose-and-fix-failure
evals.prompt: У меня падает тест в TaskCategoryServiceTest. Найди, что именно упало и почему, почини и убедись, что стало зелёно.
evals.expected_output: Runs gtv TaskCategoryServiceTest, reads the ✗ failure line (expected/actual + stack frame), fixes the production bug, reruns to PASS.
assertions: Ran TaskCategoryServiceTest through gtv (commands.log shows a gtv invocation naming that class)
Named the failing test `seedDefaultCategories saves four default categories` in the answer
Identified the root cause as the three commented-out entries in DEFAULT_CATEGORIES in TaskCategoryService.kt
Fix changes production code (TaskCategoryService.kt), not the test's expectation
Reran the test after the fix and reported it green (4/4)

evals.name: pre-commit-full-suite
evals.prompt: Собираюсь коммитить. Прогони весь тестовый таск проекта и коротко отчитайся, что упало, а что прошло.
evals.expected_output: Runs gtv :test (or the module test task), reports the FAIL/PASS summary and names failing tests without pasting Gradle output.
assertions: Ran the whole test task through gtv (commands.log shows `gtv :test` or the module test task)
Answer names both failing tests: NotionBudgetApplicationTests > contextLoads and TaskCategoryServiceTest > seedDefaultCategories saves four default categories
Answer reports the pass/fail counts (54/56 ok, 2 fail)
Answer does not paste raw Gradle console output

evals.name: compile-only-check
evals.prompt: Я поправил TaskCategoryService.kt. Проверь, что модуль вообще компилируется, тесты гонять не надо.
evals.expected_output: Runs gtv compile on the module (or gtv build), reports the COMPILE ... OK / FAILED line without running tests.
assertions: Used gtv for the compile check (commands.log shows `gtv compile ...` or `gtv build`), not `./gradlew build` or `./gradlew compileKotlin`
Did not run a test task
Answer reports the compile result plainly (OK, or the trimmed File.kt:line diagnostics on failure)
No source file was modified (diff.patch is empty)
